modules.title: Everyday Essentials
modules.description: Foundational spoken interactions for daily life

lessons.title: Ordering at a Cafe
lessons.scenario: You are at a local coffee shop ordering a drink and snack.
lessons.objective: Practice polite requests and clarifying preferences
samplePhrases: Could I please have a cappuccino?
Do you have oat milk available?
How much does that come to?

bridgeNotes.ta: கஃபேவில் மரியாதையாக காபி ஆர்டர் செய்யும் உரையாடல்.

lessons.title: Asking for Directions
lessons.scenario: You are near the central station looking for the library.
lessons.objective: Practice asking location questions and understanding directional cues
samplePhrases: Excuse me, could you tell me where the library is?

lessons.title: Introducing Yourself
lessons.scenario: You meet a new colleague or neighbor for the first time.
lessons.objective: Share your name, where you live, and what you enjoy doing
samplePhrases: Hello! It is a pleasure to meet you.
I recently moved here from Chennai.
What do you enjoy doing on weekends?

modules.title: Workplace & Collaboration
modules.description: Clear and polite communication in professional settings

lessons.title: Project Standup Update
lessons.scenario: You are giving a 2-minute status update to your project team.
lessons.objective: Summarize yesterday's progress, today's goals, and potential blockers
samplePhrases: Yesterday I completed the initial draft.
Today I am focusing on testing the edge cases.
I do not anticipate any major blockers right now.

lessons.title: Politely Declining a Meeting
lessons.scenario: You have a conflict and need to reschedule a discussion.
lessons.objective: Acknowledge the invite, decline respectfully, and propose an alternative
samplePhrases: Thank you for the invite. Unfortunately, I have a prior commitment.
Would Thursday morning work better for you?

modules.title: Persuasion & Discussion
modules.description: Expressing opinions, nuance, and constructive feedback

lessons.title: Navigating a Difference of Opinion
lessons.scenario: You and a partner disagree on the best solution for a problem.
lessons.objective: Validate their perspective while articulating your rationale clearly
samplePhrases: I see your point regarding speed, but reliability is our key risk.
What if we phased the rollout to mitigate that concern?
Let's look at the data before making the final call.
